/audio/yahuh/kokoro-heart/yahuh-01-proli.speechText: prolific. Definition: Producing a large amount of work or many results. In this passage, the stories borrowed the authority of a prolific astronomer.

/audio/yahuh/kokoro-heart/yahuh-01-inhab.speechText: inhabitants. Definition: People or creatures that live in a particular place. In this passage, readers wanted to learn about the moon’s supposed inhabitants.

/audio/yahuh/kokoro-heart/yahuh-01-satir.speechText: satire. Definition: Writing that uses humor or exaggeration to expose foolishness or criticize ideas. In this passage, the author contrasts a deceptive hoax with possible satire.

/audio/yahuh/kokoro-heart/yahuh-02-quay-.speechText: quay. Definition: A platform beside water where ships load or unload. In this passage, the islanders gather at the quay for news.

/audio/yahuh/kokoro-heart/yahuh-02-pligh.speechText: plight. Definition: A difficult or unfortunate situation. In this passage, the islanders’ plight resembles a wider problem.

/audio/yahuh/kokoro-heart/yahuh-02-conte.speechText: contemplated. Definition: Considered or planned. In this passage, people contemplated enterprises using an outdated picture of the world.

/audio/yahuh/kokoro-heart/yahuh-03-scarc.speechText: scarcely. Definition: Barely; almost not. In this passage, Pinocchio has scarcely spoken when his nose grows.

/audio/yahuh/kokoro-heart/yahuh-03-extra.speechText: extraordinary. Definition: Far beyond what is usual or ordinary. In this passage, his nose reaches an extraordinary length.

/audio/yahuh/kokoro-heart/yahuh-03-prodi.speechText: prodigiously. Definition: To an enormous or remarkable degree. In this passage, Pinocchio's nose grows prodigiously as he lies.

/audio/yahuh/kokoro-heart/yahuh-04-conte.speechText: contending. Definition: Arguing against one another. In this passage, printers publish contending writers.

/audio/yahuh/kokoro-heart/yahuh-04-animo.speechText: animosity. Definition: Strong hostility or resentment. In this passage, a printer may publish animosity without sharing it.

/audio/yahuh/kokoro-heart/yahuh-04-count.speechText: countenance. Definition: Approve of or give support to. In this passage, Franklin refuses work that might countenance vice.

/audio/yahuh/kokoro-heart/yahuh-05-assum.speechText: assumptions. Definition: Ideas accepted as a starting point for reasoning. In this passage, weather models use assumptions about future conditions.

/audio/yahuh/kokoro-heart/yahuh-05-geost.speechText: geostationary. Definition: Orbiting so as to stay above the same area of Earth. In this passage, a geostationary satellite repeatedly watches the same region.

/audio/yahuh/kokoro-heart/yahuh-05-resol.speechText: resolution. Definition: The level of detail a measurement or image can show. In this passage, high resolution lets satellites show detailed weather patterns.

/audio/yahuh/kokoro-heart/yahuh-06-placa.speechText: placards. Definition: Large printed notices displayed in public. In this passage, the sellers carry placards announcing the invasion.

/audio/yahuh/kokoro-heart/yahuh-06-dispa.speechText: dispatch. Definition: A report sent from the scene of an event. In this passage, the dispatch sounds optimistic despite heavy losses.

/audio/yahuh/kokoro-heart/yahuh-06-ruthl.speechText: ruthlessly. Definition: Without pity or concern for what is sacrificed. In this passage, the newspaper ruthlessly removes its usual contents.

/audio/yahuh/kokoro-heart/yahuh-07-impos.speechText: impostors. Definition: People or things presenting a misleading appearance. In this passage, Triumph and Disaster are called impostors.

/audio/yahuh/kokoro-heart/yahuh-07-knave.speechText: knaves. Definition: Dishonest or deceitful people. In this passage, knaves twist truthful words into a trap.

/audio/yahuh/kokoro-heart/yahuh-07-sinew.speechText: sinew. Definition: Tough tissue joining muscle to bone; also a symbol of physical strength. In this passage, the speaker calls on heart, nerve, and sinew to persevere.

/audio/yahuh/kokoro-heart/yahuh-08-libel.speechText: libeled. Definition: Harmed by a published false statement about one’s reputation. In this passage, Sullivan claimed the newspaper had libeled him.

/audio/yahuh/kokoro-heart/yahuh-08-appea.speechText: appeal. Definition: A request for a higher court to review a lower court’s decision. In this passage, the newspaper lost an appeal in Alabama.

/audio/yahuh/kokoro-heart/yahuh-08-malic.speechText: malice. Definition: Legal definition here: knowledge of falsity or reckless disregard for whether a statement is false. In this passage, actual malice concerns what the publisher knew or recklessly disregarded.

/audio/yahuh/kokoro-heart/yahuh-09-skewi.speechText: skewing. Definition: Distorting something so that it gives an inaccurate impression. In this passage, missing context risks skewing readers’ understanding.

/audio/yahuh/kokoro-heart/yahuh-09-cavea.speechText: caveats. Definition: Warnings or qualifications that explain limits or uncertainties. In this passage, reporters should include caveats about unreviewed research.

/audio/yahuh/kokoro-heart/yahuh-09-provo.speechText: provocative. Definition: Likely to stir up a strong emotional reaction. In this passage, provocative images can spread misleading impressions.
